name: Decrease the Sum of Digits
title: D. Decrease the Sum of Digits
legend:
You are given a positive integer n. In one move, you can increase n by one (i.e. make n:=n+1). Your task is to find the minimum number of moves you need to perform in order to make the sum of digits of n be less than or equal to s.

You have to answer t independent test cases.
input_spec:
The first line of the input contains one integer t (1≤t≤2⋅104) — the number of test cases. Then t test cases follow.

The only line of the test case contains two integers n and s (1≤n≤1018; 1≤s≤162).
output_spec: For each test case, print the answer: the minimum number of moves you need to perform in order to make the sum of digits of n be less than or equal to s.
